title.full: Checking a number reported by mistake

summary.text: Check the number in ScamShield. If it is wrongly marked as scam, call 1799 to request an unblock.

details.heading: One report is not enough
details.body: A single report does not automatically mark a phone number as a scam. If the number is legitimate, it will not be incorrectly marked based on one report.

steps.name: Check the number
steps.text: Use the Check for Scams feature in the ScamShield app to check whether the number is marked as scam.

steps.name: Check the result
steps.text: A number is blocked only when the result is red and says, "Beware, this looks like a scam."

steps.name: Request an unblock
steps.text: If you believe the number was wrongly marked as scam, call the ScamShield Helpline at 1799 and request an unblock.

sources.page_title: What should I do if I accidentally reported a number as scam?

quotes.text: If you've accidentally reported a number as "scam", you may use the Check for Scams feature to check if the phone number is marked as scam in the ScamShield database.
A phone number is only blocked if the check outcome appears red with the message "Beware, this looks like a scam."
If you believe a phone number has been wrongly marked as scam, please reach out to the ScamShield Helpline at 1799 to request an unblock.
Please be assured that a single report alone does not automatically mark a phone number as a scam.
